content: No maintained pure-Dart Secret Service client exists on pub.dev (secret_service, libsecret, gnome_keyring, dart_keyring all absent). The generic keyring 1.0.0 (kingwill101, 2026-06-27) exists but has 0 likes and 9 downloads/30d - unproven. package:dbus 0.7.15 (canonical, 2026-08-20, 6M downloads/30d) can drive org.freedesktop.secrets directly, but a correct client must implement OpenSession (plain or dh-ietf1024-sha256-aes128-cbc-pkcs7), Collection unlocking via the Prompt interface, and Item search/create - several hundred lines. Flatpak-sandboxed apps should not talk to org.freedesktop.secrets; the sandbox path is org.freedesktop.portal.Secret RetrieveSecret, which returns an opaque per-application master secret (expand with a KDF) rather than a secret store.
